name: Leaden Aegis
description: Wear an aegis of such density that blows slow and stop before they touch the user.

name: Crater Palm
description: Strike a palm that leaves a crater in stone and a hollow in the guard behind it.

name: Chained Weights
description: Chain a foe with weights drawn from all around until it cannot lift a single limb.

name: Pull Sunder
description: Pull in two directions at once on a structure and split it where it stands.

name: Thousand Weights
description: Set a thousand weights on a great foe one after another until it is laid out flat.

name: World Core
description: Draw the pull of the ground toward the user's core and loose it as one crushing wave.

name: Eternal Anchor
description: Cast an anchor of unmoving weight that holds the user and allies against any force.

name: Heavy Tide
description: Raise a tide of dense weight that washes over a field and carries all upon it down.

name: Weight Everlasting
description: The school move that lays a weight on a foe that does not wear off while the user lives.

name: Mass Sovereign
description: The school move that makes the user so massive that lighter techniques cannot touch them.

name: Pull Unending
description: The school move that draws all things to the user and holds them there against their will.

name: Worldfall
description: Gather the weight of many worlds and let it fall upon a field to the ceiling of its tier.

name: Gravity Itself
description: Hold the pull of existence in the user's hand so that things fall wherever the user decides.
